description: Makes a new printable math worksheet for one topic as a PDF, with a separate copy that includes the answer key. Every call gives a fresh version of the problems. Topics are identified by the topic ids that the topic search returns.

count.description: Number of problems, up to 40. Defaults to 20.

levels.description: Difficulty: any of easy, medium, hard. Defaults to the page default.

questionTypes.description: Optional question type ids for the topic, as returned by the topic search, to narrow the sheet.

topic.description: Topic id, as returned by the topic search, e.g. "factoring-trinomials".

version.description: Optional version number, to get the same sheet again.

name: create_worksheet
title: Make a printable worksheet
